how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:mage-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1860:details:0: We mages have a task that needs doing. One that is vital to the safety of ⟦E1⟧ and Elwynn forest.
rows.quest:1860:details:1: BJennea Cannon has the details. She studies in the wizard's sanctum, in the mage district of ⟦E1⟧. You should make your way to her with haste.
rows.quest:1860:completion:0: You have been sent to aid me in my task, ⟦1⟧? Good. It is heartening to see young mages eager to help in our cause...
rows.quest:1860:completion:1: BWhat cause, you ask? In time, young one. You shall know... in time.
rows.quest:1861:obj:0: Bring a Mirror Lake sample to Jennea Cannon in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1861:details:0: This world has been victim to massive mystic struggles, which tore magic currents from once stable channels. We struggle to determine the effects these changes have caused, and some of us fear the worst!
rows.quest:1861:details:1: BBut I will reveal more of this later. Right now, we need you to gather information.
rows.quest:1861:details:2: BHere, take this flask. Go to the base of the waterfall at Mirror Lake, southwest of the ⟦E1⟧ gates, and retrieve a sample of the water there. Return it to me so that I might test it for magical taints.
rows.quest:1861:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦2⟧. I will test this water for magical properties. Let us hope that it contains none, or we may find that those who drink from Mirror Lake for too long will be adversely affected.
rows.quest:1861:completion:1: BHere, ⟦3⟧. Take this orb or staff as a token of your service. May it serve you well.
rows.quest:1879:details:0: ⟦4⟧! Bink, my gnome colleague in ⟦E2⟧, sends word. She has a task that needs doing and won't rely on anyone but a mage to do it! Are you that mage, ⟦5⟧?
rows.quest:1879:details:1: BIf so, then speak with Bink. She spends her time in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward of ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:1879:completion:0: Oh, I can see you have promise, yes you do! But it takes more than promise to be a good mage. And if you're not a good mage, then you're a bad mage. And bad mages are part of the problem, yes they are!
rows.quest:1879:completion:1: BOops, I'm getting ahead of things. Let's begin at the start!
rows.quest:1880:details:0: We mages do more than just waggle our fingers and make pretty sparks! We control magic, the base fabric of our world! And that takes great care, and resolve. And knowledge... so much knowledge!
rows.quest:1880:details:1: BOne of my devices, the mage-tastic gizmonitor, collects and stores that knowledge in huge amounts! But it's lost! When we fled our home of Gnomeregan, I left it in a chest in one of our huts outside the city, and now the place is crawling with leper gnomes!
rows.quest:1880:completion:0: Oh, splendid day! When I made the gizmonitor I never realized how dependent on it I would become. Now I can begin my studies anew!
rows.quest:1880:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦7⟧! And here--these were my first tools as a mage. They're a little scratched but they're well tested. Take your pick--I'm sure you'll find either of them useful.
rows.quest:1881:details:0: ⟦8⟧, Anastasia Hartwell has a task for someone of your talents. Speak with her in the Magic Quarter of the ⟦E3⟧, and prepare yourself for your first task for the mages of the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1881:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦9⟧. You were wise to answer my call, and wiser still if you heed what I next say...
rows.quest:1882:obj:0: Bring Balnir Snapdragons to Anastasia Hartwell in the Mage Quarter of the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1882:details:0: The ⟦E5⟧ to the east are an aberration. Devised by the Lich King, they spread their magic into the soil, corrupting and killing all that live. Although there is a certain charm to the destructive forces of the plague, we, the mages of the ⟦E4⟧, believe it is unruly and must be curtailed.
rows.quest:1882:details:1: BBut first, we must measure how far it has spread into Tirisfal. Go to the Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal. In the garden are flowers--snapdragons. Gather these and return.
rows.quest:1882:completion:0: Ah, a fine specimen this is. I will send it to be studied by our apothecaries to determine the extent of the Plagueland's taint.
rows.quest:1882:completion:1: BWell done, ⟦10⟧. For your services, I present to you this choice: an orb or staff. Whichever you choose, you will find it quite useful.
rows.quest:1883:details:0: Un'thuwa, tribal mage of Sen'jin Village, detects a disturbance in the magic currents of ⟦E6⟧ and asks for aid. Speak with Un'thuwa and do what you can to help him.
rows.quest:1883:details:1: BDo this, and in time further secrets will be revealed to you.
rows.quest:1883:completion:0: Hail, ⟦11⟧. Praise to you, for my call for aid is now answered. Let us hope you are up to the task...
rows.quest:1884:obj:0: Destroy 4 Ju-Ju Heaps, then return to Un'thuwa in Sen'jin Village.
rows.quest:1884:details:0: The warlock Zalazane of the Echo Isles has disrupted the normal flow of magic in ⟦E6⟧. He does this through tainted fetishes, ju-ju heaps, which he has placed among his huts on the main Echo Isle.
rows.quest:1884:details:1: BThese heaps corrupt our wildlife and give power to the warlocks and infernal creatures that lurk in the land's dark corners.
rows.quest:1884:details:2: BYou must destroy the ju-ju heaps, ⟦12⟧, before the flow of magic is forever altered.
rows.quest:1884:completion:0: I sense that Zalazane's ju-ju heaps were destroyed, and with time, and luck, the flow of magic in ⟦E6⟧ will return to normal.
rows.quest:1884:completion:1: BA great deed you have done for your people, ⟦13⟧. And you have shown your worth to us, the mages of the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:1919:details:0: Your knowledge of the craft grows, young ⟦14⟧. Are you now ready to begin your true lessons? Are you ready to take your place in the secret war we wage?
rows.quest:1919:details:1: BIf so, then speak with Jennea Cannon, in the wizard's sanctum in the mage district of ⟦E1⟧. She has a task for you which will open your first window into the invisible world.
rows.quest:1919:completion:0: ⟦15⟧, I have a mission for you, here in the mage district. Listen closely, for there is no time to waste.
rows.quest:1920:obj:0: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment coffers from behind Jennea Cannon. Bring 3 Filled Containment Coffers to Jennea at the Wizard's Sanctum.
rows.quest:1920:details:0: A disturbance has been reported at the Blue Recluse tavern in the Mage Quarter. Strange, invisible creatures now wander the tavern, and I fear a mana rift has formed there.
rows.quest:1920:details:1: BI want you to investigate the tavern and capture those creatures. Use the cantation of manifestation in the tavern to make the creatures visible, subdue them then use a containment coffer to capture them. When you have enough, return to me with your filled coffers, your empty coffers and the cantation.
rows.quest:1920:completion:0: Very well done! I will study these creatures and, with diligence and luck, determine how they slipped into our world.
rows.quest:1920:completion:1: BYour value to the society of mages grows, ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:1921:obj:0: Bring 10 Linen Cloth and the 6 Charged Rift Gems to Wynne Larson in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1921:details:0: You have served your fellow mages well, and now it is time to don your wizard's robe. Wynne Larson can make your robe, but you must bring her the needed materials
rows.quest:1921:details:1: BThe robe will be made of ⟦E8⟧ which is easy to find, but you must also gain charged rift gems, and the only known location of the gems is in the Silver Stream Mine of ⟦E9⟧, left in crates by the dwarven miners' league.
rows.quest:1921:details:2: BGather the ⟦E8⟧ and the gems and bring them to Wynne Larson at the Larson Clothiers in the Mage District.
rows.quest:1921:completion:0: Yes, these are great pieces of ⟦E8⟧. I can make a fine robe with them. And after I weave the rift gems into it, we'll have a garment fit for a mage!
rows.quest:1938:obj:0: Bring Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic to High Sorcerer Andromath in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1938:details:0: Long ago, three mages studied in this tower until one fell to the dark arts. He was urged to turn away from that evil magic, but he could not resist. And so he was banished.
rows.quest:1938:details:1: BThe fallen mage's new domain is the tower of Ilgalar in Redridge, and he took with him a powerful book--Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic.
rows.quest:1938:details:2: BWe, the mages of ⟦E1⟧, would have that book returned. Enter the tower of Ilgalar, find the tome in his library, and bring it to me.
rows.quest:1938:completion:0: I feared that Morganth had hidden the book elsewhere, or that he had found a way to open it and read its contents.
rows.quest:1938:completion:1: BIt is good to see that he did not, and that the seals we placed on Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic still hold.
rows.quest:1939:details:0: High Sorcerer Andromath wishes to speak with you, ⟦17⟧. He is at the top of the wizard's sanctum, in the mage's district of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1939:details:1: BIt would be wise to speak with him, for Andromath is one of the most powerful mages not locked away in ⟦E10⟧. Council with him is high council indeed.
rows.quest:1939:completion:0: Greetings, ⟦18⟧. I am pleased to see you, and hope you have time to listen to an old man's words...
rows.quest:1940:obj:0: Bring 8 Pristine Spider Silk to Wynne Larson in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1940:details:0: Your service has been unwavering, ⟦19⟧. I think, perhaps, it is time you had a finer garment, one more suiting your station as an adept mage. If you gather the needed materials, then we will arrange the robe made.
rows.quest:1940:details:1: BYou must enter ⟦E11⟧ and hunt carrion recluse spiders. Extract their ⟦E12⟧, but only the finest, most pristine ⟦E12⟧ will do. When you have enough, take it to Wynne Larson, here in the mage district at the Larson Clothiers. She will craft your robe.
rows.quest:1940:completion:0: Nice specimens, these. I'll get right to work!
rows.quest:1941:completion:0: Here is your robe. It's one of my best made yet! Wear it with pride, and when people ask... tell them you got it at the Larson Clothiers!
rows.quest:1942:completion:0: Your garment is ready! And that ⟦E12⟧ you gathered was so nice... you don't mind if I made it a little short so that I'd have some ⟦E12⟧ left over for me, do you?
rows.quest:1942:completion:1: BI'm only joking. It'll fit you great, and will be perfect for both adventure and formal dining. Enjoy!
rows.quest:1943:details:0: The troll mage Deino has need of your assistance, ⟦20⟧. She resides in ⟦E13⟧, in the Darkbriar Lodge.
rows.quest:1943:completion:0: Good, you have come. My task is not an easy one, but vital to the society of mages. If you aid me, I am sure you will find it worthwhile.
rows.quest:1944:obj:0: Bring the Xavian Water Sample to Deino in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:1944:details:0: The fabled city of Xavian lies nestled deep within eastern ⟦E14⟧, and tales of its ancient knowledge are well known among the learned. It is said that the waters of Xavian hold vast magical powers.
rows.quest:1944:details:1: BI would have a sample of those waters, from their source.
rows.quest:1944:details:2: BTake this flask and go to Xavian. Gather water from the bottom of its highest waterfall, and return to me. And use care as you move through that ancient city--satyrs now hold the ruins and do not like mages prying into their affairs.
rows.quest:1944:completion:0: Ah, very good. I trust the satyrs of Xavian gave you little trouble?
rows.quest:1944:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦21⟧. I will study this sample of Xavian water immediately.
rows.quest:1945:obj:0: Bring 12 Laughing Sister's Hairs to Kil'hala at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:1945:details:0: For your services, I have arranged for the creation of your new robes, provided you can gather the needed materials...
rows.quest:1945:details:1: BFor these robes, you must return to ⟦E14⟧ for the locks of hair from laughing sisters--dryads who gather near the Raynewood Retreat.
rows.quest:1945:details:2: BWhen you have their hair, bring it to Kil'hala, a troll tailor at the Crossroads in the ⟦E15⟧. He will be expecting you, and will fashion your robes.
rows.quest:1945:completion:0: Ah, this hair will weave into a fine robe, ⟦22⟧. It is a pity the laughing sisters had to die to part with it, though I do doubt they would ever give it willingly.
rows.quest:1945:completion:1: BA pity, but only a small one.
rows.quest:1946:completion:0: Here is your nether-lace, ⟦23⟧. It is both comfortable and durable, and holds the magic of the laughing sisters' hair.
rows.quest:1946:completion:1: BEnjoy, and if you find it amenable, please mention so to Deino. She is a mage on whose good side I wish to stay...
rows.quest:1947:details:0: Now it is time for you to earn your mage's wand. To begin this quest, speak with the human hermit Tabetha in ⟦E16⟧. You will find her shack deep in the marsh, west of ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:1947:details:1: BSpeak with her, for her knowledge is vast. You will find Tabetha's cottage west of ⟦E17⟧, and just north of the Stonemaul Ruins.
rows.quest:1947:completion:0: Quiet! I'm in a delicate juncture and mustn't be disturbed!
rows.quest:1948:obj:0: Bring 1 Jade and the Bolt Charged Bramble to Tabetha in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:1948:details:0: The building of a mage's wand is not easy. Rare substances are required, and a vessel must be made that can store great quantities of magical energy. You must gather these things and bring them to me.
rows.quest:1948:details:1: BI have written onto this parchment that which you need, and instructions on how to get it. Bring me exactly what is on this list, and follow my written directions to the letter, for if you do not then when we make your wand things might go... badly.
rows.quest:1948:completion:0: Aha! You got the jade and made the bramble! Well done!
rows.quest:1948:completion:1: BIs that smoke I see rising from your ears? You might have gotten too close when the lightning struck the totem sticks, but don't worry. Being hit by lightning is good luck!
rows.quest:1949:obj:0: Speak with Magus Tirth in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1949:details:0: To make your wand, there are key passages in a certain book that I must read. The book is called Rituals of Power, written by the Magus Tirth.
rows.quest:1949:details:1: BI do not have a copy of his book, and none of the world's great libraries possess it. So you must speak with Tirth and gain it from him.
rows.quest:1949:details:2: BGood luck. Tirth used to be a great mage and scholar, but now he spends his time at the gnome and goblin races in the Shimmering Flats, drinking and gambling.
rows.quest:1949:completion:0: What? Speak up! These old ears aren't as sharp as they used to be.
rows.quest:1949:completion:1: BWell, I hope you're here with a fresh mug of ale or some hot tips on the next race! If not, then you best keep walking... because I have a polymorph wand with your name on it!
rows.quest:1950:obj:0: Find the phrase to Tirth's strongbox, then return to Tirth.
rows.quest:1950:details:0: I can help you with the book, but first you have to help me!
rows.quest:1950:details:1: BThe tome you seek is in my magically locked strongbox. To open it a special phrase must be uttered, and I can't remember the phrase! Normally my assistant helps me remember these things but he's nowhere to be found.
rows.quest:1950:details:2: BIf you want my book, then find my apprentice! Ask around the race track--if you're lucky then someone has seen him. Either drag him back here, or at least get my magic phrase from him so we can open my box!
rows.quest:1950:completion:1: BI had forgotten about that little curse I put on Johnson. I can't remember why I did it but I'm sure it served him right, the little ingrate!
rows.quest:1951:obj:0: Bring the book Rituals of Power to Tabetha in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:1951:details:0: Hm... now that I think about it, I don't have my book! You see, I had some gambling debts and to pay them off I sold the last copy of Rituals of Power to a member of the clergy....
rows.quest:1951:details:1: BA member of the ⟦E18⟧ Brotherhood. He must have taken it to their library in the ⟦E18⟧ Monastery in ⟦E19⟧!
rows.quest:1951:details:2: BIf you want that book, then you'll have to go to the monastery to find it. And sorry about all the trouble. I'm not myself these days...
rows.quest:1951:completion:0: That's it! It's just what I need to prepare for the ritual to create your wand! I hope it wasn't too much trouble to find...
rows.quest:1952:obj:0: Speak with Tabetha after her ritual.
rows.quest:1952:details:0: I'll go make the wands now.
rows.quest:1952:completion:0: Here are the wands I made. Take your pick!
rows.quest:1953:details:0: It is time, ⟦24⟧, for you to speak with Tabetha... the hermit of ⟦E16⟧. She will instruct you on the creation of a powerful mage's implement.
rows.quest:1953:details:1: BTabetha's shack lies deep in ⟦E16⟧, west of ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:1953:completion:0: Ah, yes. You are here for an orb or a staff, ⟦25⟧? Very well. I will aid you in its construction.
rows.quest:1953:completion:1: BBut be forewarned--the process is a perilous one and could mean your death.
rows.quest:1953:completion:2: BOr my death. Definitely someone's death...
rows.quest:1953:completion:3: BBut let's hope it's someone else's death, eh?
rows.quest:1954:obj:0: Bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:1954:details:0: The first step is to acquire an orb with power. The warlocks of the Burning Blade have nice, high quality orbs... it's too bad they've bound demons into them! But we can fix that, yes we can.
rows.quest:1954:details:1: BGo to ⟦E20⟧ and snatch an infernal orb from a Burning Blade summoner. You'll find summoners at the Mannoroc Coven.
rows.quest:1954:details:2: BWhen you have the orb, return to me.
rows.quest:1954:completion:0: Oh, that's a nice one! No, I don't mean it's "nice" like cool juice is nice on a hot day.
rows.quest:1954:completion:1: BIn fact, it's very NOT nice now that I think about it. Not the juice. The orb!
rows.quest:1954:completion:2: BFocus, ⟦26⟧! We'll need you focused if we're ever to finish our task!
rows.quest:1955:obj:0: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.
rows.quest:1955:details:0: Now that we have a summoner's orb, we must exorcise the demon within it. I can do that. That's the easy part.
rows.quest:1955:details:1: BYou're the one who has the hard job. You're the one who has to kill the demon once it's out.
rows.quest:1955:details:2: BAnd you'll have to be quick. If you take too long then he'll jump back in the orb and we'll have to start over!
rows.quest:1955:details:3: BSo get yourself ready. Prepare your strongest spells and keep your potions handy, and go get a friend if you have one. Because this isn't going to be pretty.
rows.quest:1955:completion:0: Nicely done, ⟦27⟧! You gave that demon a lesson he won't soon forget.
rows.quest:1955:completion:1: BHe'll think twice before he sticks his ugly head back in this world, looking for the stupid mortal who beat him. Probably with friends this time. Big, scaly friends who'd want nothing more than to tear you into little ⟦28⟧ pieces.
rows.quest:1955:completion:2: BI didn't scare you, did I...⟦29⟧?
rows.quest:1956:obj:0: Retrieve an Obsidian Power Source and bring it to Tabetha in ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:1956:details:0: Now that the demon has been removed, we must gain a power source. Unfortunately, the best power sources are usually the oldest and the hardest to get. It's neat how fate likes to take a bite out of you sometimes, isn't it?
rows.quest:1956:details:1: BSo you're going to need to go to Uldaman and defeat the obsidian sentinel there. He's big, he's tough, and his power source packs a punch!
rows.quest:1956:details:2: BI wish you the best of luck, ⟦30⟧. And if you don't get lucky then, well... it was nice knowing you.
rows.quest:1956:completion:1: BI was chatting with some of my colleagues and when your name came up they said, "You know that ⟦31⟧ sure works well under stress!"
rows.quest:1956:completion:2: BBut when I told them I sent you to Uldaman against the obsidian sentinel, they said I was crazy! They said, "Tabetha, you're crazy! There's no way ⟦32⟧ could take on that sentinel!"
rows.quest:1956:completion:3: BAnd I said, "We'll see", and then they said "Yeah, we'll see..."
rows.quest:1956:completion:4: BWell we sure showed them, didn't we!
rows.quest:1957:obj:0: Kill 12 Mana Surges in the allowed time limit.
rows.quest:1957:details:0: We are almost finished, but this last step is the most perilous, ⟦33⟧.
rows.quest:1957:details:1: BI have the empty summoner's orb and am ready to empower it. We will do this by harnessing the energy of a mana rift. I'll cast a spell that will temporarily open a rift, from which creatures, mana surges, will pour out. You must defeat the mana surges and their power will be released, which I will then collect.
rows.quest:1957:details:2: BKill enough mana surges before the rift closes and I will place all their collected energy in your orb.
rows.quest:1957:completion:0: You did it! I never doubted you for a second! Ok, maybe for just a second, or two... but basically I didn't have much doubt.
rows.quest:1958:completion:0: You should be proud of yourself, ⟦34⟧. Many mages have fallen to the creatures you faced.
rows.quest:1958:completion:1: BThe Celestial Orb is ready. Or if you'd like I can mount it atop a staff. It's up to you. I'd prefer the orb, but who am I to judge?
rows.quest:1959:details:0: The mages of the ⟦E3⟧ have noted a magical disturbance within the city, and have sent word for mages of the ⟦E7⟧ to investigate.
rows.quest:1959:details:1: BAnastasia Hartwell can tell you more. Speak with her in the Magic Quarter in the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1959:completion:0: It is true. A magical disturbance has been detected in our city. We are not yet sure of its origin, or whether it is malign or benign. We must first gather more information...
rows.quest:1959:completion:1: BAnd that, ⟦35⟧, brings us to your task.
rows.quest:1960:obj:0: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment Coffers from behind Anastasia Hartwell. Bring 3 Filled Containment Coffers, the Chest of Containment Coffers and the Cantation of Manifestation to Anastasia in the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:1960:details:0: Algernon's alchemist shop in the Apothecarium is the locus of a strange disturbance. Invisible creatures, made solely of magic, wander the shop--there must be a reason, and we must find it!
rows.quest:1960:details:1: BInvestigate the disturbance and capture those creatures. Take a chest of coffers and a scroll from behind me. Use the scroll at the shop to make the creatures visible, subdue them with your spells, then throw down a coffer to capture them. Return with the filled coffers, the empty coffers and the cantation.
rows.quest:1960:completion:0: Very good, ⟦36⟧. The creatures within these containment coffers will be studied by our finest minds, and the reason behind their presence in the ⟦E3⟧ will be determined.
rows.quest:1960:completion:1: BIf their appearance is caused by a rift in the natural flow of magic, then we must determine if the rift was random. If it was not random, but instead an attack by some magical force, then we must prepare for future, more serious disturbances.
rows.quest:1961:obj:0: Bring 10 Linen Cloth and 6 ⟦E10⟧ Mana Gems to Josef Gregorian.
rows.quest:1961:details:0: It is time for you to don your first mage's robes, ⟦37⟧. They are a sign of your station, and a testament to your worth.
rows.quest:1961:details:1: BTo gain the robes, you must gather the mana gems from the ⟦E10⟧ mages of Silverpine. Their beliefs are similar to ours and so killing them is somewhat distasteful, but if they lack the strength to resist us, then they do not deserve their lives.
rows.quest:1961:details:2: BBring the gems and a supply of ⟦E8⟧ to Josef Gregorian at the Magic Quarter's tailor shop.
rows.quest:1961:completion:0: This is very good material, and although I lack the talent to gauge the quality of these mana gems, we'll soon know if they possess the power needed to create spellfire robes...
rows.quest:1962:completion:0: Here are your robes, ⟦38⟧. Wear them well.
rows.quest:3086:obj:0: Read the Glyphic Tablet and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:3086:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, ⟦39⟧.
rows.quest:3086:details:1: BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:3086:completion:0: You be among da most powerful beings on da planet, ⟦40⟧... there no arguin' dat. And everyone know it... know it good, too!
rows.quest:3086:completion:1: BBut ya must be weary! 'cause it not orc, or elf, or dwarf dat you should be scared of... it be da tings you can'na see. Magic be powerful. Make you do tings you may not want to do. Make ya tink you more powerful then you really be. Be patient. Be smart.
rows.quest:3086:completion:2: BWhen ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.
rows.quest:3098:obj:0: Read the Glyphic Scroll and speak to Isabella in the church in Deathknell.
rows.quest:3098:details:0: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the mage trainer Isabella. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
rows.quest:3098:completion:0: You must return to me often if you are to become powerful enough to destroy those who would oppose us. The rules of magic still apply to you, ⟦41⟧. You will still find corruption follows you like hungry wolves in the night. You will find its caress is not unlike an addiction, an old lover still wanting to be by your side. But these things can be staved off. These things will only control you if you allow them to.
rows.quest:3098:completion:1: BGo now, return to me when you've grown more powerful.
rows.quest:3104:obj:0: Read the Glyphic Letter and speak to Khelden Bremen inside ⟦E21⟧ Abbey.
rows.quest:3104:details:0: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, ⟦42⟧. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Khelden, our local mage trainer. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
rows.quest:3104:completion:0: Haha, I knew my note would not dissuade you from your path. So, you're prepared then, are you? Prepared to accept your fate? Prepared to challenge the gods and any other forces that stand before you in the pursuit of knowledge and power?
rows.quest:3104:completion:1: BI will not lie, ⟦43⟧, you will be feared as much as respected. But also know this, I will be here for you when you need training. Simply seek me out as you grow more powerful.
rows.quest:3114:obj:0: Read the Glyphic Memorandum and speak to Marryk Nurribit inside Anvilmar above Coldridge Valley.
rows.quest:3114:details:0: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the mage trainer Marryk. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
rows.quest:3114:completion:1: BHere's what you need to know, ⟦44⟧: Don't get into too much trouble. Save some coin to buy me an ale... or any spells ya might want. And stay the heck away from Gnomeregan. Other than that, have a good day! I'll be here if you need me or want to train... or whatever.
